example-with-pull-requests.landHint: Land with `python .claude/scripts/land.py --merge-integration` — other agents are landing into development at the same time, so the base must come down before you push.

example-without-pull-requests.landHint: Cut the worktree with `pnpm feature start <name>` and land with `pnpm feature land` (ADR 0005: no pull request). `land` fetches and rebases onto development itself; if it refuses on a conflict, resolve it in the worktree and run `pnpm feature land` again.

example-holding-one-gpu.gateWhy: one GPU and one CPU, and every arm here wants all of both — a second training run started while the first is alive does not queue, it OOMs
example-holding-one-gpu.landHint: Land with `python .claude/scripts/land.py --merge-integration`. The integration branch here is `main`, not development.
